"
'
Tis Harry I'm Plannin' to Marry
" is a
popular
song, with music by
Sammy Fain
and lyrics by
Paul Francis Webster
.
The song was included in the hit musical
Calamity Jane
(
1953
).
[
1
]
It is featured three times in the film. It is first sung by the character Adelaide Adams (
Gale Robbins
), then by Katie Brown (
Allyn McLerie
) after dressing up as Adelaide, and finally partly sung in the Golden Garter by Katie near the end of the film.
